blurb:
Taste your way through Historic Downtown Grapevine, where Texas food, local favorites and wine come together along historic Main Street. Enjoy 8 generous tastings with plenty of food for a meal at handpicked local stops, from Tex-Mex and house-smoked brisket at veteran-owned AJ’s on Main to a sweet treat at an artisan food hall and a custom olive oil trio tasting.

Between bites, discover the people and stories behind Grapevine, from its agricultural and railroad roots to its rise as one of North Texas’ best-known wine destinations. Explore historic Main Street, local landmarks and stories most visitors walk right past.

Finish at Messina Hof Grapevine Winery, inside a re-creation of the historic 1891 Wallis Hotel, with an included splash of Texas wine. Stay afterward and enjoy more time at the winery.

Texas food, local stories and a taste of Grapevine wine country—all in one delicious walk down historic Main Street.
